proof:
have hiter : ∀ t : ℕ, (x ^ t) ((y ^ t) v) =
    ((t.factorial : ℂ) * ∏ j ∈ Finset.range t, ((l - (j : ℤ) : ℤ) : ℂ)) • v := by
  intro t
  induction t with
  | zero => simp
  | succ t ih =>
    have hr := h_T001.2.2.2.2.2 (t + 1) (by omega)
    rw [pow_succ, Module.End.mul_apply, hr]
    simp only [Nat.add_sub_cancel, map_smul, ih, smul_smul]
    congr 1
    simp only [Nat.factorial_succ, Nat.cast_mul, Finset.prod_range_succ,
      Int.cast_mul, Int.cast_sub, Int.cast_add, Int.cast_natCast, Int.cast_one,
      Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one]
    ring
intro i
have hfact : (i.val.factorial : ℂ) ≠ 0 :=
  Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr (Nat.factorial_ne_zero i.val)
have hprod : (∏ j ∈ Finset.range i.val, ((l - (j : ℤ) : ℤ) : ℂ)) ≠ 0 := by
  apply Finset.prod_ne_zero_iff.mpr
  intro j hj
  have hjlt : j < i.val := Finset.mem_range.mp hj
  have hi : (i.val : ℤ) ≤ l := (h_T001.2.1 i).2
  have hpos : 0 < l - (j : ℤ) := by omega
  exact Int.cast_ne_zero.mpr (ne_of_gt hpos)
have hy : (y ^ i.val) v ≠ 0 := by
  intro hz
  have he := hiter i.val
  rw [hz, map_zero] at he
  exact (smul_ne_zero (mul_ne_zero hfact hprod) h_H004.1) he.symm
have hev : ev y v i.val = ((i.val.factorial : ℂ)⁻¹) • (y ^ i.val) v := rfl
constructor
· rw [hev]
  exact smul_ne_zero (inv_ne_zero hfact) hy
· rw [hev, map_smul, h_T001.2.2.2.2.1 i.val]
  exact smul_comm _ _ _
